title: अष्टाशीतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: In the afternoon Krishna visits his aunt Kunti, who embraces him and weeps for her sons, asking after each of them and Draupadi and recalling their sufferings. She sends Arjuna and Bhima a message to remember the purpose for which a Kshatriya woman bears sons, and Krishna comforts her and takes leave.
summary.kn: ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಅತ್ತೆ ಕುಂತಿಯನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅವಳು ಅವನನ್ನು ಅಪ್ಪಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಅಳುತ್ತಾ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರೌಪದಿಯ ಕುಶಲ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವರ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನೆಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯಸ್ತ್ರೀ ಯಾವ ಉದ್ದೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಹೆರುತ್ತಾಳೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನೆನೆಯಿರಿ ಎಂದು ಅರ್ಜುನ ಭೀಮರಿಗೆ ಸಂದೇಶ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ; ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಸಾಂತ್ವನ ಹೇಳಿ ಬೀಳ್ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: दोपहर में श्रीकृष्ण अपनी बुआ कुन्ती से मिलते हैं, जो उन्हें गले लगाकर पुत्रों के लिए रोती हैं, प्रत्येक का और द्रौपदी का कुशल पूछती हैं और उनके कष्ट याद करती हैं। वे अर्जुन और भीम को सन्देश भेजती हैं कि वे याद रखें कि क्षत्रिय स्त्री किस उद्देश्य से पुत्र जनती है, और श्रीकृष्ण उन्हें सान्त्वना देकर विदा लेते हैं।
summary.te: మధ్యాహ్నం శ్రీకృష్ణుడు అత్త కుంతిని సందర్శిస్తాడు; ఆమె ఆయనను కౌగిలించి కుమారుల కోసం ఏడుస్తూ ఒక్కొక్కరి, ద్రౌపది కుశలం అడిగి వారి కష్టాలను గుర్తుచేసుకుంటుంది. క్షత్రియస్త్రీ ఏ ఉద్దేశంతో కుమారులను కంటుందో గుర్తుంచుకోమని అర్జునునికి, భీమునికి సందేశం పంపుతుంది; శ్రీకృష్ణుడు ఆమెను ఓదార్చి సెలవు తీసుకుంటాడు.
summary.ta: மதியம் ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் அத்தை குந்தியைச் சந்திக்க, அவள் அவரைத் தழுவி மைந்தர்களுக்காக அழுது, ஒவ்வொருவரையும் திரௌபதியையும் விசாரித்து அவர்கள் துன்பங்களை நினைவுகூர்கிறாள். க்ஷத்ரியப் பெண் எதற்காக மைந்தர்களைப் பெறுகிறாள் என்பதை நினைவில் கொள்ளுமாறு அர்ஜுனனுக்கும் பீமனுக்கும் செய்தி அனுப்புகிறாள்; ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் அவளைத் தேற்றி விடைபெறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ഉച്ചതിരിഞ്ഞ് കൃഷ്ണൻ അമ്മായി കുന്തിയെ സന്ദർശിക്കുന്നു; അവൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ആലിംഗനം ചെയ്ത് മക്കളെക്കുറിച്ച് കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ട്, ഓരോരുത്തരെയും ദ്രൗപദിയെയും കുറിച്ച് അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ കഷ്ടപ്പാടുകൾ ഓർമ്മിക്കുന്നു. ക്ഷത്രിയസ്ത്രീ മക്കളെ പ്രസവിക്കുന്നത് ഏത് ലക്ഷ്യത്തിനുവേണ്ടിയാണെന്ന് ഓർമ്മിക്കാൻ അർജുനനും ഭീമനും അവൾ സന്ദേശം അയയ്ക്കുന്നു; കൃഷ്ണൻ അവളെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിച്ച് യാത്ര പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.88; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अथोपगम्य विदुरमपराह्णे जनार्दनः ।
पितृष्वसारं गोविन्दः सोऽभ्यगच्छदरिंदमः ॥

meaning.en: Then, after meeting Vidura, in the afternoon Janardana, subduer of foes, went to see his father's sister.

verses.text:
सा दृष्ट्वा कृष्णमायान्तं प्रसन्नादित्यवर्चसम् ।
कण्ठे गृहीत्वा प्राक्रोशत्पृथा पार्थाननुस्मरन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Krishna come, bright as the gracious sun, Pritha embraced him round the neck and cried out, remembering her sons.

verses.text:
तेषां सत्त्ववतां मध्ये गोविन्दं सहचारिणम् ।
चिरस्य दृष्ट्वा वार्ष्णेयं बाष्पमाहारयत्पृथा ॥

meaning.en: Seeing after so long Varshneya, Govinda, who had been the companion of those valiant sons, Pritha shed tears.

verses.text:
साब्रवीत्कृष्णमासीनं कृतातिथ्यं युधां पतिम् ।
बाष्पगद्गदपूर्णेन मुखेन परिशुष्यता ॥

meaning.en: To Krishna, lord of warriors, seated and hospitably received, she spoke, her face dry, her voice choked with tears.

verses.text:
ये ते बाल्यात्प्रभृत्येव गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः ।
परस्परस्य सुहृदः संमताः समचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: Those who from childhood were devoted to serving their elders, friends to one another, esteemed and of one mind,

verses.text:
निकृत्या भ्रंशिता राज्याज्जनार्हा निर्जनं गताः ।
विनीतक्रोधहर्षाश्च ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यवादिनः ॥

meaning.en: were cast out of the kingdom by deceit, though worthy of company went into solitude, restrained in anger and joy, devoted to brahmanas and truthful.

verses.text:
त्यक्त्वा प्रियसुखे पार्था रुदन्तीमपहाय माम् ।
अहार्षुश्च वनं यान्तः समूलं हृदयं मम ॥

meaning.en: The Parthas gave up what was dear and pleasant, left me weeping, and as they went to the forest they carried away my heart, root and all.

verses.text:
अतदर्हा महात्मानः कथं केशव पाण्डवाः ।
ऊषुर्महावने तात सिंहव्याघ्रगजाकुले ॥

meaning.en: Keshava, how did the great-souled Pandavas, undeserving of it, live in a great forest teeming with lions, tigers and elephants?

verses.text:
बाला विहीनाः पित्रा ते मया सततलालिताः ।
अपश्यन्तः स्वपितरौ कथमूषुर्महावने ॥

meaning.en: Young, deprived of their father and ever cherished by me, not seeing their parents, how did they live in the great forest?

verses.text:
शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्मृदङ्गैर्वैणवैरपि ।
पाण्डवाः समबोध्यन्त बाल्यात्प्रभृति केशव ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, from childhood the Pandavas were awakened with the sound of conches and drums, of mridangas and flutes.

verses.text:
ये स्म वारणशब्देन हयानां हेषितेन च ।
रथनेमिनिनादैश्च व्यबोध्यन्त सदा गृहे ॥

meaning.en: They were always awakened at home by the trumpeting of elephants, the neighing of horses and the sound of chariot wheels.

verses.text:
शङ्खभेरीनिनादेन वेणुवीणानुनादिना ।
पुण्याहघोषमिश्रेण पूज्यमाना द्विजातिभिः ॥

meaning.en: They were honored by twice-born men with the sound of conches and kettledrums, echoing with flute and lute, mingled with auspicious chanting.

verses.text:
वस्त्रै रत्नैरलंकारैः पूजयन्तो द्विजन्मनः ।
गीर्भिर्मङ्गलयुक्ताभिर्ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Honoring brahmins with garments, jewels and ornaments, they were delighted with blessings from great brahmanas.

verses.text:
अर्चितैरर्चनार्हैश्च स्तुवद्भिरभिनन्दिताः ।
प्रासादाग्रेष्वबोध्यन्त राङ्कवाजिनशायिनः ॥

meaning.en: Praised and welcomed by those worthy of honor whom they had honored, they were awakened on the roofs of palaces, sleeping on deerskin blankets.

verses.text:
ते नूनं निनदं श्रुत्वा श्वापदानां महावने ।
न स्मोपयान्ति निद्रां वै अतदर्हा जनार्दन ॥

meaning.en: Surely, Janardana, hearing the cries of wild beasts in the great forest, they do not find sleep, undeserving of it.

verses.text:
भेरीमृदङ्गनिनदैः शङ्खवैणवनिस्वनैः ।
स्त्रीणां गीतनिनादैश्च मधुरैर्मधुसूदन ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, how were they awakened in the great forest, they who had been woken by drums, mridangas, conches and flutes and the sweet songs of women,

verses.text:
बन्दिमागधसूतैश्च स्तुवद्भिर्बोधिताः कथम् ।
महावने व्यबोध्यन्त श्वापदानां रुतेन ते ॥

meaning.en: and by bards, magadhas and sutas praising them, by the cries of beasts of prey?

verses.text:
ह्रीमान्सत्यधृतिर्दान्तो भूतानामनुकम्पिता ।
कामद्वेषौ वशे कृत्वा सतां वर्त्मानुवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Modest, firm in truth, self-controlled, compassionate to all beings, having mastered desire and hatred, he follows the path of the good.

verses.text:
अम्बरीषस्य मान्धातुर्ययातेर्नहुषस्य च ।
भरतस्य दिलीपस्य शिबेरौशीनरस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Of Ambarisha, Mandhata, Yayati, Nahusha, Bharata, Dilipa and Shibi Aushinara,

verses.text:
राजर्षीणां पुराणानां धुरं धत्ते दुरुद्वहाम् ।
शीलवृत्तोपसंपन्नो धर्मज्ञः सत्यसंगरः ॥

meaning.en: he bears the burden, hard to carry, of the ancient royal sages, endowed with good conduct, knowing dharma, true to his word.

verses.text:
राजा सर्वगुणोपेतस्त्रैलोक्यस्यापि यो भवेत् ।
अजातशत्रुर्धर्मात्मा शुद्धजाम्बूनदप्रभः ॥

meaning.en: He is a king endowed with every virtue, fit to rule even the three worlds, Ajatashatru, righteous, bright as pure gold.

verses.text:
श्रेष्ठः कुरुषु सर्वेषु धर्मतः श्रुतवृत्ततः ।
प्रियदर्शनो दीर्घभुजः कथं कृष्ण युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, how is Yudhishthira, foremost of all the Kurus in dharma, learning and conduct, handsome and long-armed?

verses.text:
यः स नागायुतप्राणो वातरंहा वृकोदरः ।
अमर्षी पाण्डवो नित्यं प्रियो भ्रातुः प्रियंकरः ॥

meaning.en: And Vrikodara, with the strength of ten thousand elephants and the speed of the wind, Pandava ever intolerant, dear to his brother and doing his pleasure,

verses.text:
कीचकस्य च सज्ञातेर्यो हन्ता मधुसूदन ।
शूरः क्रोधवशानां च हिडिम्बस्य बकस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, the slayer of Kichaka and his kinsmen, the hero who killed the Krodhavashas, Hidimba and Baka,

verses.text:
पराक्रमे शक्रसमो वायुवेगसमो जवे ।
महेश्वरसमः क्रोधे भीमः प्रहरतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: equal to Shakra in prowess, to the wind in speed, to Maheshvara in wrath, Bhima, best of fighters,

verses.text:
क्रोधं बलममर्षं च यो निधाय परंतपः ।
जितात्मा पाण्डवोऽमर्षी भ्रातुस्तिष्ठति शासने ॥

meaning.en: the scorcher of foes who keeps his anger, strength and impatience in check, self-controlled and intolerant, stays under his brother's command.

verses.text:
तेजोराशिं महात्मानं बलौघममितौजसम् ।
भीमं प्रदर्शनेनापि भीमसेनं जनार्दन ।
तं ममाचक्ष्व वार्ष्णेय कथमद्य वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: That mass of splendor, great soul, flood of strength and boundless vigor, Bhima, fearsome even to look at, Janardana, tell me how Vrikodara is today, Varshneya.

verses.text:
आस्ते परिघबाहुः स मध्यमः पाण्डवोऽच्युत ।
अर्जुनेनार्जुनो यः स कृष्ण बाहुसहस्रिणा ।
द्विबाहुः स्पर्धते नित्यमतीतेनापि केशव ॥

meaning.en: Achyuta, how is the middle Pandava, with arms like iron bars, who is Arjuna, who with only two arms always rivals the thousand-armed Arjuna of old, Krishna?

verses.text:
क्षिपत्येकेन वेगेन पञ्च बाणशतानि यः ।
इष्वस्त्रे सदृशो राज्ञः कार्तवीर्यस्य पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava who shoots five hundred arrows in a single burst, equal in archery to King Kartavirya,

verses.text:
तेजसादित्यसदृशो महर्षिप्रतिमो दमे ।
क्षमया पृथिवीतुल्यो महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: equal to the sun in splendor, to a great sage in self-control, to earth in patience, to Mahendra in prowess,

verses.text:
आधिराज्यं महद्दीप्तं प्रथितं मधुसूदन ।
आहृतं येन वीर्येण कुरूणां सर्वराजसु ॥

meaning.en: by whose might the great, shining, famed sovereignty of the Kurus was won over all the kings, Madhusudana,

verses.text:
यस्य बाहुबलं घोरं कौरवाः पर्युपासते ।
स सर्वरथिनां श्रेष्ठः पाण्डवः सत्यविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: whose fearsome arm-strength the Kauravas attend upon, that best of all chariot-warriors, Pandava of true valor,

verses.text:
योऽपाश्रयः पाण्डवानां देवानामिव वासवः ।
स ते भ्राता सखा चैव कथमद्य धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: who is the refuge of the Pandavas as Vasava is of the gods: how is he, your brother and friend, Dhananjaya?

verses.text:
दयावान्सर्वभूतेषु ह्रीनिषेधो महास्त्रवित् ।
मृदुश्च सुकुमारश्च धार्मिकश्च प्रियश्च मे ॥

meaning.en: Compassionate to all beings, modest, a master of great weapons, gentle, tender, righteous and dear to me,

verses.text:
सहदेवो महेष्वासः शूरः समितिशोभनः ।
भ्रातॄणां कृष्ण शुश्रूषुर्धर्मार्थकुशलो युवा ॥

meaning.en: Sahadeva the great archer, hero, ornament of any gathering, young and skilled in dharma and profit, who serves his brothers, Krishna,

verses.text:
सदैव सहदेवस्य भ्रातरो मधुसूदन ।
वृत्तं कल्याणवृत्तस्य पूजयन्ति महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: his brothers always honor Sahadeva's conduct, Madhusudana, for his is excellent behavior.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठापचायिनं वीरं सहदेवं युधां पतिम् ।
शुश्रूषुं मम वार्ष्णेय माद्रीपुत्रं प्रचक्ष्व मे ॥

meaning.en: Tell me of him, Varshneya: Sahadeva, hero, lord of warriors, who honors his elder, Madri's son, who attends me.

verses.text:
सुकुमारो युवा शूरो दर्शनीयश्च पाण्डवः ।
भ्रातॄणां कृष्ण सर्वेषां प्रियः प्राणो बहिश्चरः ॥

meaning.en: Tender, young, brave and handsome, the Pandava is dear to all his brothers, Krishna, like their life-breath outside the body.

verses.text:
चित्रयोधी च नकुलो महेष्वासो महाबलः ।
कच्चित्स कुशली कृष्ण वत्सो मम सुखैधितः ॥

meaning.en: And Nakula, a wonderful fighter, great archer, of great strength: is that child of mine, raised in comfort, well, Krishna?

verses.text:
सुखोचितमदुःखार्हं सुकुमारं महारथम् ।
अपि जातु महाबाहो पश्येयं नकुलं पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Accustomed to happiness, undeserving of suffering, tender, a great chariot-warrior: mighty-armed one, shall I ever see Nakula again?

verses.text:
पक्ष्मसंपातजे काले नकुलेन विनाकृता ।
न लभामि सुखं वीर साद्य जीवामि पश्य माम् ॥

meaning.en: Bereft of Nakula, I find no happiness even for the time of an eyelash's fall, hero; look at me, I live even so.

verses.text:
सर्वैः पुत्रैः प्रियतमा द्रौपदी मे जनार्दन ।
कुलीना शीलसंपन्ना सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः ॥

meaning.en: Draupadi, Janardana, is dearer to me than all my sons, of good family, virtuous, endowed with every excellence.

verses.text:
पुत्रलोकात्पतिलोकान्वृण्वाना सत्यवादिनी ।
प्रियान्पुत्रान्परित्यज्य पाण्डवानन्वपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: She chose the world of husbands over the world of sons, truthful, and leaving her dear sons followed the Pandavas.

verses.text:
महाभिजनसंपन्ना सर्वकामैः सुपूजिता ।
ईश्वरी सर्वकल्याणी द्रौपदी कथमच्युत ॥

meaning.en: Of high birth, honored with every comfort, mistress and all-auspicious, how is Draupadi, Achyuta?

verses.text:
पतिभिः पञ्चभिः शूरैरग्निकल्पैः प्रहारिभिः ।
उपपन्ना महेष्वासैर्द्रौपदी दुःखभागिनी ॥

meaning.en: Joined with five heroic husbands, fire-like and great archers and fighters, Draupadi still shares in sorrow.

verses.text:
चतुर्दशमिमं वर्षं यन्नापश्यमरिंदम ।
पुत्राधिभिः परिद्यूनां द्रौपदीं सत्यवादिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: This is the fourteenth year, subduer of foes, that I have not seen truthful Draupadi, burning with grief for her sons.

verses.text:
न नूनं कर्मभिः पुण्यैरश्नुते पुरुषः सुखम् ।
द्रौपदी चेत्तथावृत्ता नाश्नुते सुखमव्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: Surely a man does not gain happiness by good deeds, if Draupadi, of such conduct, does not enjoy lasting happiness.

verses.text:
न प्रियो मम कृष्णाय बीभत्सुर्न युधिष्ठिरः ।
भीमसेनो यमौ वापि यदपश्यं सभागताम् ॥

meaning.en: Neither Bibhatsu, nor Yudhishthira, nor Bhimasena, nor the twins are as dear to me as Krishna, since I saw her brought into the assembly.

verses.text:
न मे दुःखतरं किंचिद्भूतपूर्वं ततोऽधिकम् ।
यद्द्रौपदीं निवातस्थां श्वशुराणां समीपगाम् ॥

meaning.en: Nothing sadder has ever happened to me than that: Draupadi, who had stood sheltered from the wind, brought before her fathers-in-law.

verses.text:
आनायितामनार्येण क्रोधलोभानुवर्तिना ।
सर्वे प्रैक्षन्त कुरव एकवस्त्रां सभागताम् ॥

meaning.en: Dragged by the ignoble man, who followed anger and greed, in one cloth, all the Kurus saw her in the assembly.

verses.text:
तत्रैव धृतराष्ट्रश्च महाराजश्च बाह्लिकः ।
कृपश्च सोमदत्तश्च निर्विण्णाः कुरवस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Right there were Dhritarashtra, the great king Bahlika, Kripa and Somadatta, and the Kurus were distressed.

verses.text:
तस्यां संसदि सर्वस्यां क्षत्तारं पूजयाम्यहम् ।
वृत्तेन हि भवत्यार्यो न धनेन न विद्यया ॥

meaning.en: Of that whole assembly I honor only Kshattri; for a man is noble by conduct, not by wealth or learning.

verses.text:
तस्य कृष्ण महाबुद्धेर्गम्भीरस्य महात्मनः ।
क्षत्तुः शीलमलंकारो लोकान्विष्टभ्य तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, the character of that wise, deep, great-souled Kshattri is an ornament, and it supports the worlds.

verses.text:
सा शोकार्ता च हृष्टा च दृष्ट्वा गोविन्दमागतम् ।
नानाविधानि दुःखानि सर्वाण्येवान्वकीर्तयत् ॥

meaning.en: Grieved and glad at seeing Govinda come, she recounted all her many kinds of sorrow.

verses.text:
पूर्वैराचरितं यत्तत्कुराजभिररिंदम ।
अक्षद्यूतं मृगवधः कच्चिदेषां सुखावहम् ॥

meaning.en: Dice and hunting, which wicked kings of old practiced, subduer of foes, bring happiness to them, do they not?

verses.text:
तन्मां दहति यत्कृष्णा सभायां कुरुसंनिधौ ।
धार्तराष्ट्रैः परिक्लिष्टा यथा नकुशलं तथा ॥

meaning.en: That burns me, that Krishna in the assembly in the presence of the Kurus was so tormented by the Dhartarashtras, undeservedly.

verses.text:
निर्वासनं च नगरात्प्रव्रज्या च परंतप ।
नानाविधानां दुःखानामावासोऽस्मि जनार्दन ।
अज्ञातचर्या बालानामवरोधश्च केशव ॥

meaning.en: Exile from the city and wandering in the forest, scorcher of foes, I am the dwelling of many kinds of sorrow, Janardana: life incognito, and the confinement of my children, Keshava.

verses.text:
न स्म क्लेशतमं मे स्यात्पुत्रैः सह परंतप ।
दुर्योधनेन निकृता वर्षमद्य चतुर्दशम् ॥

meaning.en: Scorcher of foes, my sufferings with my sons, cheated by Duryodhana, have reached this fourteenth year; was it not the greatest?

verses.text:
दुःखादपि सुखं न स्याद्यदि पुण्यफलक्षयः ।
न मे विशेषो जात्वासीद्धार्तराष्ट्रेषु पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: If the fruit of merit is spent, there is no happiness even after sorrow; yet I never saw any difference between the Dhartarashtras and the Pandavas.

verses.text:
तेन सत्येन कृष्ण त्वां हतामित्रं श्रिया वृतम् ।
अस्माद्विमुक्तं संग्रामात्पश्येयं पाण्डवैः सह ।
नैव शक्याः पराजेतुं सत्त्वं ह्येषां तथागतम् ॥

meaning.en: By that truth, Krishna, may I see you with your enemies slain, crowned with glory, freed from this battle with the Pandavas; for their spirit is such that they cannot be conquered.

verses.text:
पितरं त्वेव गर्हेयं नात्मानं न सुयोधनम् ।
येनाहं कुन्तिभोजाय धनं धूर्तैरिवार्पिता ॥

meaning.en: I would blame only my father, not myself and not Suyodhana, who gave me like wealth to Kuntibhoja, as if by gamblers.

verses.text:
बालां मामार्यकस्तुभ्यं क्रीडन्तीं कन्दुहस्तकाम् ।
अददात्कुन्तिभोजाय सखा सख्ये महात्मने ॥

meaning.en: When I was a child playing with a ball in my hand, my father, a friend to a friend, gave me to the great Kuntibhoja.

verses.text:
साहं पित्रा च निकृता श्वशुरैश्च परंतप ।
अत्यन्तदुःखिता कृष्ण किं जीवितफलं मम ॥

meaning.en: Cheated by my father and by my in-laws, scorcher of foes, in great sorrow, Krishna, what is the fruit of my life?

verses.text:
यन्मा वागब्रवीन्नक्तं सूतके सव्यसाचिनः ।
पुत्रस्ते पृथिवीं जेता यशश्चास्य दिवं स्पृशेत् ॥

meaning.en: At the birth of Savyasachin a voice said to me at night: your son will conquer the earth and his fame will touch the heaven.

verses.text:
हत्वा कुरून्ग्रामजन्ये राज्यं प्राप्य धनंजयः ।
भ्रातृभिः सह कौन्तेयस्त्रीन्मेधानाहरिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Having killed the Kurus in the war, Dhananjaya, winning the kingdom, will perform with his brothers three sacrifices.

verses.text:
नाहं तामभ्यसूयामि नमो धर्माय वेधसे ।
कृष्णाय महते नित्यं धर्मो धारयति प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: I do not blame that word; I bow to dharma the creator, to great Krishna; dharma holds up the people.

verses.text:
धर्मश्चेदस्ति वार्ष्णेय तथा सत्यं भविष्यति ।
त्वं चापि तत्तथा कृष्ण सर्वं संपादयिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: If there is dharma, Varshneya, that will be true; and you, Krishna, will bring all that about.

verses.text:
न मां माधव वैधव्यं नार्थनाशो न वैरिता ।
तथा शोकाय भवति यथा पुत्रैर्विनाभवः ॥

meaning.en: Madhava, neither widowhood, nor loss of wealth, nor enmity brings me as much grief as separation from my sons.

verses.text:
याहं गाण्डीवधन्वानं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम् ।
धनंजयं न पश्यामि का शान्तिर्हृदयस्य मे ॥

meaning.en: Not seeing Dhananjaya, wielder of Gandiva, best of bearers of all weapons, what peace can my heart have?

verses.text:
इदं चतुर्दशं वर्षं यन्नापश्यं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
धनंजयं च गोविन्द यमौ तं च वृकोदरम् ॥

meaning.en: This is the fourteenth year that I have not seen Yudhishthira, Dhananjaya, the twins and Vrikodara, Govinda.

verses.text:
जीवनाशं प्रनष्टानां श्राद्धं कुर्वन्ति मानवाः ।
अर्थतस्ते मम मृतास्तेषां चाहं जनार्दन ॥

meaning.en: People perform the shraddha for those who have disappeared, ending their living claim; in truth they are dead to me, and I to them, Janardana.

verses.text:
ब्रूया माधव राजानं धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
भूयांस्ते हीयते धर्मो मा पुत्रक वृथा कृथाः ॥

meaning.en: Madhava, tell King Yudhishthira, the righteous: your dharma is greatly lost; do not, my son, act in vain.

verses.text:
पराश्रया वासुदेव या जीवामि धिगस्तु माम् ।
वृत्तेः कृपणलब्धाया अप्रतिष्ठैव ज्यायसी ॥

meaning.en: Vasudeva, shame on me, who live on others' support; for a livelihood won through wretchedness, having no place of one's own is better.

verses.text:
अथो धनंजयं ब्रूया नित्योद्युक्तं वृकोदरम् ।
यदर्थं क्षत्रिया सूते तस्य कालोऽयमागतः ॥

meaning.en: And tell Dhananjaya and Vrikodara, always ready: the time has come for which a kshatriya woman bears sons.

verses.text:
अस्मिंश्चेदागते काले कालो वोऽतिक्रमिष्यति ।
लोकसंभाविताः सन्तः सुनृशंसं करिष्यथ ॥

meaning.en: If this time has come and you let it pass, then though esteemed by the world you will do a very cruel thing.

verses.text:
नृशंसेन च वो युक्तांस्त्यजेयं शाश्वतीः समाः ।
काले हि समनुप्राप्ते त्यक्तव्यमपि जीवितम् ॥

meaning.en: And I would abandon you for ever, if you were bound up in cruelty; when the time has come, even life must be given up.

verses.text:
माद्रीपुत्रौ च वक्तव्यौ क्षत्रधर्मरतौ सदा ।
विक्रमेणार्जितान्भोगान्वृणीतं जीवितादपि ॥

meaning.en: And tell the sons of Madri, who are always devoted to kshatriya dharma: choose enjoyments won by valor over life itself.

verses.text:
विक्रमाधिगता ह्यर्थाः क्षत्रधर्मेण जीवतः ।
मनो मनुष्यस्य सदा प्रीणन्ति पुरुषोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Best of men, wealth gained by valor delights the mind of a man who lives by the kshatriya dharma.

verses.text:
गत्वा ब्रूहि महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम् ।
अर्जुनं पाण्डवं वीरं द्रौपद्याः पदवीं चर ॥

meaning.en: Go, mighty-armed one, and tell Arjuna the Pandava, best of all weapon-bearers: follow the path of Draupadi.

verses.text:
विदितौ हि तवात्यन्तं क्रुद्धाविव यथान्तकौ ।
भीमार्जुनौ नयेतां हि देवानपि परां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: You know well those two, Bhima and Arjuna, who when angry are like two Deaths; they could lead even the gods to the highest end.

verses.text:
तयोश्चैतदवज्ञानं यत्सा कृष्णा सभां गता ।
दुःशासनश्च कर्णश्च परुषाण्यभ्यभाषताम् ॥

meaning.en: And this was the insult to them, that Krishna was brought into the assembly, and Duhshasana and Karna spoke harsh words.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनो भीमसेनमभ्यगच्छन्मनस्विनम् ।
पश्यतां कुरुमुख्यानां तस्य द्रक्ष्यति यत्फलम् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana approached the proud Bhimasena before the chief Kurus; he will see the fruit of that.

verses.text:
न हि वैरं समासाद्य प्रशाम्यति वृकोदरः ।
सुचिरादपि भीमस्य न हि वैरं प्रशाम्यति ।
यावदन्तं न नयति शात्रवाञ्शत्रुकर्शनः ॥

meaning.en: Having met an enemy, Vrikodara does not quiet down; Bhima's enmity does not cool even after a long time, until the scorcher of foes brings his enemies to an end.

verses.text:
न दुःखं राज्यहरणं न च द्यूते पराजयः ।
प्रव्राजनं च पुत्राणां न मे तद्दुःखकारणम् ॥

meaning.en: Neither the seizure of the kingdom, nor defeat at dice, nor my sons' exile is the cause of my grief.

verses.text:
यत्तु सा बृहती श्यामा एकवस्त्रा सभां गता ।
अशृणोत्परुषा वाचस्ततो दुःखतरं नु किम् ॥

meaning.en: But that the tall, dark woman, in one cloth, heard harsh words in the assembly: what is sadder than that?

verses.text:
स्त्रीधर्मिणी वरारोहा क्षत्रधर्मरता सदा ।
नाध्यगच्छत्तथा नाथं कृष्णा नाथवती सती ॥

meaning.en: Fair-hipped, devoted to women's dharma and always to the kshatriya dharma, Krishna, though she had husbands, found no protector.

verses.text:
यस्या मम सपुत्रायास्त्वं नाथो मधुसूदन ।
रामश्च बलिनां श्रेष्ठः प्रद्युम्नश्च महारथः ॥

meaning.en: You, Madhusudana, are the protector of me and my sons, and Rama, best of the strong, and the great chariot-warrior Pradyumna.

verses.text:
साहमेवंविधं दुःखं सहेऽद्य पुरुषोत्तम ।
भीमे जीवति दुर्धर्षे विजये चापलायिनि ॥

meaning.en: Yet I endure such sorrow today, best of men, though fierce Bhima lives and Vijaya, never fleeing.

verses.text:
तत आश्वासयामास पुत्राधिभिरभिप्लुताम् ।
पितृष्वसारं शोचन्तीं शौरिः पार्थसखः पृथाम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Shauri, friend of Partha, comforted his father's sister Pritha, sorrowing, flooded with grief for her sons.

verses.text:
का नु सीमन्तिनी त्वादृग्लोकेष्वस्ति पितृष्वसः ।
शूरस्य राज्ञो दुहिता आजमीढकुलं गता ॥

meaning.en: Father's sister, what woman in the worlds is there like you, daughter of King Shura, married into the family of Ajamidha?

verses.text:
महाकुलीना भवती ह्रदाद्ध्रदमिवागता ।
ईश्वरी सर्वकल्याणी भर्त्रा परमपूजिता ॥

meaning.en: Of great family, you have come like one going from one lake to another; you are a mistress, all-auspicious, honored by your husband.

verses.text:
वीरसूर्वीरपत्नी च सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः ।
सुखदुःखे महाप्राज्ञे त्वादृशी सोढुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: Mother of heroes, wife of a hero, endowed with every virtue: a woman as wise as you can bear both pleasure and pain.

verses.text:
निद्रातन्द्री क्रोधहर्षौ क्षुत्पिपासे हिमातपौ ।
एतानि पार्था निर्जित्य नित्यं वीराः सुखे रताः ॥

meaning.en: The Parthas, heroes who are ever devoted to joy, have conquered sleep and drowsiness, anger and delight, hunger and thirst, cold and heat.

verses.text:
त्यक्तग्राम्यसुखाः पार्था नित्यं वीरसुखप्रियाः ।
न ते स्वल्पेन तुष्येयुर्महोत्साहा महाबलाः ॥

meaning.en: The Parthas have renounced common pleasures and love heroes' joy; being greatly energetic and strong they would not be content with little.

verses.text:
अन्तं धीरा निषेवन्ते मध्यं ग्राम्यसुखप्रियाः ।
उत्तमांश्च परिक्लेशान्भोगांश्चातीव मानुषान् ॥

meaning.en: The steadfast resort to the extremes; those who love common pleasures remain in the middle. They accept the greatest hardships, or enjoyments beyond the human.

verses.text:
अन्तेषु रेमिरे धीरा न ते मध्येषु रेमिरे ।
अन्तप्राप्तिं सुखामाहुर्दुःखमन्तरमन्तयोः ॥

meaning.en: The steadfast delight in the extremes, not in the middle; they call reaching an end happiness, and what lies between the two is sorrow.

verses.text:
अभिवादयन्ति भवतीं पाण्डवाः सह कृष्णया ।
आत्मानं च कुशलिनं निवेद्याहुरनामयम् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas salute you, together with Krishna, and tell you of their own welfare and health.

verses.text:
अरोगान्सर्वसिद्धार्थान्क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि पाण्डवान् ।
ईश्वरान्सर्वलोकस्य हतामित्राञ्श्रिया वृतान् ॥

meaning.en: You will soon see the Pandavas healthy, with all aims accomplished, lords of the whole world, their enemies slain and crowned with glory.

verses.text:
एवमाश्वासिता कुन्ती प्रत्युवाच जनार्दनम् ।
पुत्राधिभिरभिध्वस्ता निगृह्याबुद्धिजं तमः ॥

meaning.en: Thus comforted, Kunti, overwhelmed by sorrow for her sons, replied to Janardana, restraining the darkness born of ignorance.

verses.text:
यद्यत्तेषां महाबाहो पथ्यं स्यान्मधुसूदन ।
यथा यथा त्वं मन्येथाः कुर्याः कृष्ण तथा तथा ॥

meaning.en: Mighty-armed Madhusudana, whatever is beneficial for them, as you think best, Krishna, do that.

verses.text:
अविलोपेन धर्मस्य अनिकृत्या परंतप ।
प्रभावज्ञास्मि ते कृष्ण सत्यस्याभिजनस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Without loss of dharma, without deceit, scorcher of foes, I know the power of your truth and your family.

verses.text:
व्यवस्थायां च मित्रेषु बुद्धिविक्रमयोस्तथा ।
त्वमेव नः कुले धर्मस्त्वं सत्यं त्वं तपो महत् ॥

meaning.en: I know your resolve among friends and your wisdom and valor; you are the dharma in our family, you are truth, you are great austerity.

verses.text:
त्वं त्राता त्वं महद्ब्रह्म त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
यथैवात्थ तथैवैतत्त्वयि सत्यं भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: You are our protector, you are the great Brahman; all is established in you. What you have said will be true in you.

verses.text:
तामामन्त्र्य च गोविन्दः कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम् ।
प्रातिष्ठत महाबाहुर्दुर्योधनगृहान्प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Taking leave of her and circling her to the right, the mighty-armed Govinda set out for Duryodhana's house.
